entries.name: 800 °C annealed phosphor
entries.caption: Illustrative specimen identity for nominal La2(MoO4)3:Yb,Er. Shapes and dimensions are explanatory, not a TEM reconstruction or refined dopant-site/lattice model. The 800 °C powder is source-assigned tetragonal with an unidentified minor second phase; that phase assignment is not generalized to every specimen. No size is interpolated from annealing temperature.
limitations: Illustrative identity/composition; no measured atomic coordinates supplied.
